plan: Keep queueing jungle as primary — it is already Willy's usual queue AND best role at 51.3% over 167 games (overall is 50.6%).
Two-hero rule for the climb: Zinx and Yin. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Willy wins about 4.2 and 2.9 more games per 100 on them.
Willy's champion pool is 12+ heroes wide and the top three are only 45% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Willy is at 475 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 903 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: The tilt tax is real for Willy
insights.finding: Right after a loss Willy wins 40%; right after a win, 62%. One cooldown break after losses is free VP.
insights.receipt: 6/15 after losses vs 8/13 after wins, last 29 games

insights.title: Deaths are creeping up
insights.finding: 5.3 deaths/game in the last 20 vs 4.0 career. Every extra death is ~25s+ of enemy free time.

insights.title: Gadget is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 224 games on Gadget at 50.5% — the field averages 49.7%. The comfort is real; the edge is roughly neutral.

insights.title: Cuban brings out Willy's best
insights.finding: Willy's record alongside Cuban Noobster is 54% over 421 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: 1 pentakill in real 5v5s and a longest spree of 23 (plus 1 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Willy has receipts.
